# Tokens

Every token of the system, a section per group: Text — 8 tokens; Fills and status backgrounds — 16 tokens; Borders and rings — 9 tokens; Charts — 8 tokens; Palette ramps and brand — 75 tokens; Type styles, families, font files; Spacing — 34 tokens; Radius — 14 tokens; Shadow — 8 tokens; Opacity — 2 tokens.

## Color · Text

### Use

```css
/* any surface that loads tokens.css or components/bundle.css */
color: var(--fg);
/* a surface with no stylesheet (a slide): the light value, or another theme’s in that mode */
```

### Tokens (8)

| token | light | dark | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `fg` | #09090b | #fafafa | Body text and headings on `bg`, `bg-subtle`, `bg-muted`, `bg-panel`. |
| `fg-muted` | #52525b | #a1a1aa | Secondary text, descriptions, helper text on `bg` and `bg-panel`. |
| `fg-subtle` | #a1a1aa | #71717a | Placeholders and disabled hints only — below 4.5:1, never for readable copy. |
| `fg-inverted` | #fafafa | #09090b | Text on `bg-inverted`. |
| `fg-error` | #ef4444 | #f87171 | Error text and icons. Light: 3.8:1 on `bg` — use at 14px bold / 18px+ or next to an icon; long error copy uses `accent-fg`. |
| `fg-warning` | #ea580c | #fdba74 | Warning icons (3:1+). For text use `warning-fg`. |
| `fg-success` | #16a34a | #86efac | Success icons (3:1+). For text use `success-fg`. |
| `fg-info` | #2563eb | #a3cfff | Info icons and short labels. |


| token | light | dark | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |

| `chart-axis` | #d4d4d8 | #3f3f46 | Baseline/axis and the crosshair. |

| `primary-border` | #e4e4e7 | #27272a | Border of outline primary buttons (decorative; the label carries the control). |

## Type

Use the named styles; no literal px.

### Use

```css
font: var(--text-\32 xs);            /* with tokens.css */
font-family: var(--font-sans);   /* the family alone */
```

### Styles

| style | CSS | size / line | weight | family | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `2xs` | `.\32 xs`, `--text-\32 xs` | 0.625rem / 0.75rem | 400 | `sans` | Tiny badges (xs). |
| `xs` | `.xs`, `--text-xs` | 0.75rem / 1rem | 400 | `sans` | Captions, xs/sm badges, xs buttons. |
| `sm` | `.sm`, `--text-sm` | 0.875rem / 1.25rem | 400 | `sans` | UI text: buttons md, inputs, labels, alerts. |
| `md` | `.md`, `--text-md` | 1rem / 1.5rem | 400 | `sans` | Body copy. Large buttons and inputs. |
| `lg` | `.lg`, `--text-lg` | 1.125rem / 1.75rem | 600 | `sans` | Lead paragraph; md card titles. |
| `xl` | `.xl`, `--text-xl` | 1.25rem / 1.875rem | 600 | `sans` | Card titles lg; small headings (h4). |
| `2xl` | `.\32 xl`, `--text-\32 xl` | 1.5rem / 2rem | 600 | `sans` | Section headings (h3). |
| `3xl` | `.\33 xl`, `--text-\33 xl` | 1.875rem / 2.375rem | 600 | `sans` | Page headings (h2). |
| `4xl` | `.\34 xl`, `--text-\34 xl` | 2.25rem / 2.75rem | 600 | `sans` | Page titles (h1). |
| `5xl` | `.\35 xl`, `--text-\35 xl` | 3rem / 3.75rem | 600 | `sans` | Hero headings. |
| `6xl` | `.\36 xl`, `--text-\36 xl` | 3.75rem / 4.5rem | 600 | `sans` | Marketing display. |
| `7xl` | `.\37 xl`, `--text-\37 xl` | 4.5rem / 5.75rem | 600 | `sans` | Largest display, landing pages. |
| `label` | `.label`, `--text-label` | 0.875rem / 1.25rem | 500 | `sans` | Form labels, button text, switch labels. |
| `code` | `.code`, `--text-code` | 0.875rem / 1.25rem | 400 | `mono` | Inline code and kbd. |
| `mono-sm` | `.mono-sm`, `--text-mono-sm` | 0.8125rem / 1.25rem | 400 | `mono` | Technical values in dense UI: IPs, ports, hashes, IDs, log lines, table cells with numbers. |

### Families

| family | CSS variable | stack |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `sans` | `--font-sans` | `Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif` |
| `mono` | `--font-mono` | `ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, "Cascadia Mono", "JetBrains Mono", Menlo, Consolas, "Liberation Mono", monospace` |

### Font files

Fonts: one file per family is enough (below: the upright face nearest regular weight; bold and italic synthesize). Fetch it as the fetch column says (Artifact tool `read`, that id or path as `path`) and upload it as an asset where you use it (`publish`, `file_path`, `asset:true`) — HTML/CSS: an `@font-face { font-family: "<family>"; src: url(<uploaded>) }` rule; a Slides deck: write `fonts/<id>` = `{"family":"<family>","src":"<the url the upload returned>"}`. `tokens.css` carries the `@font-face` rules for a page that inlines it and names each family by the CSS variable below.

| family | file | fetch | CSS | Slides `fonts/<id>` |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Inter | `fonts/Inter-latin-wght.woff2` (weight 100 900) | `read` the file with `project/` in front | `var(--font-sans)` | `inter` |

## Radius

### Use

```css
/* var(--radius-none) */
```

### Tokens (14)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `radius-none` | 0 | Tables, full-bleed media. |
| `radius-2xs` | 0.0625rem | Hairline chips. |
| `radius-xs` | 0.125rem | = `radius-l1`: checkbox, kbd, tiny marks. |
| `radius-sm` | 0.25rem | = `radius-l2`: buttons, inputs, badges (the control radius). |
| `radius-md` | 0.375rem | = `radius-l3`: cards, alerts, menus. |
| `radius-lg` | 0.5rem | Popovers, larger panels. |
| `radius-xl` | 0.75rem | Dialogs. |
| `radius-2xl` | 1rem | Hero cards, image frames. |
| `radius-3xl` | 1.5rem | Marketing blocks. |
| `radius-4xl` | 2rem | Oversized marketing blocks. |
| `radius-full` | 9999px | Pills: switch track, avatars, dot badges. |
| `radius-l1` | 0.125rem | Layer 1 radius (= xs): the smallest nested element. |
| `radius-l2` | 0.25rem | Layer 2 radius (= sm): controls — button, input, badge. |
| `radius-l3` | 0.375rem | Layer 3 radius (= md): containers — card, alert. |

## Shadow

### Use

```css
/* var(--shadow-xs) */
```

### Tokens (8)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `shadow-xs` | 0px 1px 2px rgba(24, 24, 27, 0.1), 0px 0px 1px rgba(24, 24, 27, 0.2) · dark: 0px 1px 1px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.64), 0px 0px 1px inset rgba(212, 212, 216, 0.2) | Subtle lift: switch thumb (raised), segment. |
| `shadow-sm` | 0px 2px 4px rgba(24, 24, 27, 0.1), 0px 0px 1px rgba(24, 24, 27, 0.3) · dark: 0px 2px 4px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.64), 0px 0px 1px inset rgba(212, 212, 216, 0.3) | Switch thumb, small floating chips. |
| `shadow-md` | 0px 4px 8px rgba(24, 24, 27, 0.1), 0px 0px 1px rgba(24, 24, 27, 0.3) · dark: 0px 4px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.64), 0px 0px 1px inset rgba(212, 212, 216, 0.3) | Elevated cards. |
| `shadow-lg` | 0px 8px 16px rgba(24, 24, 27, 0.1), 0px 0px 1px rgba(24, 24, 27, 0.3) · dark: 0px 8px 16px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.64), 0px 0px 1px inset rgba(212, 212, 216, 0.3) | Menus, popovers. |
| `shadow-xl` | 0px 16px 24px rgba(24, 24, 27, 0.1), 0px 0px 1px rgba(24, 24, 27, 0.3) · dark: 0px 16px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.64), 0px 0px 1px inset rgba(212, 212, 216, 0.3) | Drawers, toasts. |
| `shadow-2xl` | 0px 24px 40px rgba(24, 24, 27, 0.16), 0px 0px 1px rgba(24, 24, 27, 0.3) · dark: 0px 24px 40px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.64), 0px 0px 1px inset rgba(212, 212, 216, 0.3) | Dialogs. |
| `shadow-inner` | inset 0 2px 4px 0 rgba(9, 9, 11, 0.05) · dark: inset 0 2px 4px 0 #09090b | Recessed wells, raised-switch track. |
| `shadow-inset` | inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(9, 9, 11, 0.05) · dark: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(212, 212, 216, 0.05) | Hairline edge on images and media. |

## Opacity

### Use

```css
/* var(--opacity-disabled) */
```

### Tokens (2)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `opacity-disabled` | 0.5 | Every disabled control (with cursor: not-allowed). |
| `opacity-hover-solid` | 0.9 | Solid buttons on hover: `primary-solid` / `accent-solid` at 90%. |
